knobs.note: BH-2626. The lane's on/off switch: 0 stops the hourly self-report before it reads anything (flags/lane-off-box-self-report is the other). bin/box-self-report.sh has no literal for it and tests it as ${BOX_SELF_REPORT_ENABLED:-} = 0. With it off, rules-drift-check and cli-version-check see the row go stale and ssh the box, as before BH-2626.

Read by bin/box-self-report.sh as ${BOX_SELF_REPORT_CLAUDE_DIR:-/root/.claude}: where the CLAUDE.md whose md5 is reported lives. Test seam; NOT settable from the control plane — it is a path a root lane uses, so only env/global.env on the box moves it.

Read by bin/box-self-report.sh as ${BOX_SELF_REPORT_TIMEOUT:-30}: seconds the whole report (both --version reads and the POST) may take before it is killed and logged as failed. Test seam; NOT settable from the control plane.
